rows.Notes: Bred dragon mount breeding program facility. Construction: 150,000 gp. Capacity: 20-egg incubation + 5 bonding rooms + 10-dragon housing. Operating: 400 gp/dragon/month. Three tiers produced: Courser (CR 6), Charger (CR 11), Warmother (CR 15). Genetic stock: Klauth (primary, red dragon) + Aurixalnar (secondary, shadow dragon variant year 2+). Nafnfestr imprint ritual (Jörmun-authored Norse ausa vatni adaptation): Day 1 blood lock, Day 7 name acceptance, Day 30 wyrd-thread anchoring. Winter Dust breeding suppressant for population control. Klauth-char brazier as ritual component — every Wyrmhelm distantly aware of founding genetic ancestor without personality transfer. Inner Circle distribution projected Nightal 1495 – Hammer 1496 DR: Arik (Warmother Ambrosianeth — honey-gold with black horns, saurian maw, breed-founder), Korgan (Warmother), Vara (Charger), Shi'van (Charger), Lirien (Courser), Seliara (Charger). Second Warmother gifted to House Amaranthe ~Hammer 1497 (Aelindra Amaranthe rider, Silverymoon-based). Continental aerial dominance year 10 (1504-1505 DR): 500-800 mature Wyrmhelms, three full Wings, self-sustaining breeding population, Veil dedicated courier network. Sources: wyrmhelm-program-complete.md, Baen_Real_Estate portfolio (Institut Strategic Facilities section).
